records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Net sales were $127.6 million for the three months ended September 30, 2021 compared to $133.8 million in the three months ended September 30, 2020, a decrease of $6.2 million, or 4.6%.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: We preventatively and voluntarily closed our facilities on March 18, 2020, suspending production and shipments at all of our locations, which negatively impacted sales volumes and profitability during the shutdown period.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The decrease in sales for the three months ended September 30, 2021 compared to the same period in 2020 is a result of chassis and component shortages leading to lower production and deliveries at Work Truck Solutions.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Sales increased in the three month period as a result of pricing actions.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Net cash used in operating activities decreased $7.6 million from the nine months ended September 30, 2020 to the nine months ended September 30, 2021.
